S7_LLEN_sorento_respond_message.METHODOLOGY_FINDING_S7_IS_NOT_A_VALID_GA: S7 specifies raw 'LLEN before == LLEN after' on sorento-respond-message. That list is (a) shared with LIVE production traffic, which pushes to it continuously, and (b) drained every 5 seconds by redis-consume-queue-mongo (Srs08P0Ha3Cv--YPx0-Yn, schedule interval 5s). So the metric is BOTH false-positive prone (any concurrent real customer turn trips it, as happened here) AND false-negative prone (a genuine harness write is drained within 5s and can read back as 0). RECOMMEND UAC.md §0 S7 be rewritten to the gate actually used here: (1) sink-delta accounting on sorento-respond-message-TEST must equal the number of expected saves, and (2) any non-zero prod delta must be attributed by reading the consumer's popped payload from redis-consume-queue-mongo runData and confirming it lacks the harness markers (message_id/turn_id on an incoming row, or contact 437264483/457216562).

S8_pin_protocol.user_mandated_protocol: Pin + dev contact; assert pinData present on the workflow BEFORE executing any is_test:false run of sJI3DbsLCG01JfRs.
S8_pin_protocol.BARRIER_1_AS_LITERALLY_SPECIFIED_IS_NOT_: pinData is an argument to test_workflow, evaluated inside the same atomic call. update_workflow exposes no pinData operation (op enum: updateNodeParameters, setNodeParameter, addNode, removeNode, renameNode, addConnection, removeConnection, setNodeCredential, setNodePosition, setNodeDisabled, setNodeSettings, setWorkflowMetadata, addTags, removeTags). prepare_test_pin_data returns schemas and persists nothing. There is therefore NO way to store pin data on the workflow and inspect it before executing.
substitute_used: (a) prepare_test_pin_data(sJI3DbsLCG01JfRs) confirmed the SERVER classifies 'Send a Message', 'HTTP Request' and 'Postgres Chat Memory1' as pin-required (nodesWithoutSchema), and confirmed the two save calls are in nodesSkipped (they execute for real, into the TEST sink).

(b) The first is_test:false run was deliberately chosen to be §OBS-6 (quick_reply NON-empty). On that path 'Send a Message' is STRUCTURALLY unreachable — it is fed only by Loop Over Items, reachable only via If->TRUE->Code->If1. The credentialed respond.io sender therefore could not fire regardless of pin behaviour. That run served as a zero-exposure proof of the pin mechanism.
(c) That probe PROVED pins are honoured: exec 9391685 shows 'HTTP Request' with executionTime 0ms returning exactly the pinned payload, and the execution record carries a populated pinData block.
(d) ONLY THEN were §OBS-5 and §OBS-7 (which do reach 'Send a Message') executed, with the pin supplied and contact_identifer = 437264483 (dev contact) exclusively.

findings.title: Stale UAC case fixtures use a 3-level message shape the clone cannot read
findings.detail: n8n-workflows-init/tests/cases/*.json nest item.message.message = {text,...}. The clone resolves text at $('tf-message').first().json.message.message.text, which needs FOUR levels (item.message.message.message). Ground truth taken from live spine exec 9390932: tf-message returns the respond.io webhook body B, where B.message = D = {messageId, replyTo, message: E} and E = {type, text, attachment}. messageId lives on D. The case files would silently yield undefined text. They should be regenerated against the live shape.
